## Appendix A: sample pool appendix for make_study tests

Each entry shows the question and choices verbatim, then the correct answer with a one-line why.

> **G1A01** On which HF and/or MF amateur bands are there portions where General class licensees cannot transmit?
> A. 60 meters, 30 meters, 17 meters, and 12 meters
> B. 160 meters, 60 meters, 15 meters, and 12 meters
> C. 80 meters, 40 meters, 20 meters, and 15 meters
> D. 80 meters, 20 meters, 15 meters, and 10 meters
> **Answer: C** — the lower edges of 80, 40, 20, and 15 meters are Extra-only — taught in chapter 1.

Published ID line: `G1A01 (C) [97.301(d)]`

> **G1A02** On which of the following bands is phone operation prohibited?
> A. 160 meters
> B. 30 meters
> C. 17 meters
> D. 12 meters
> **Answer: B** — thirty meters is CW, RTTY, and data only — taught in chapter 1.

Published ID line: `G1A02 (B) [97.305]`

> **G1B01** What is the maximum height above ground for an antenna structure without notification?
> A. 50 feet
> B. 100 feet
> C. 200 feet
> D. 300 feet
> **Answer: C** — two hundred feet is the notification threshold — taught in chapter 1.

Published ID line: `G1B01 (C) [97.15(d)]`

> **G2A01** Which sideband is most commonly used for voice operation on frequencies of 14 MHz or higher?
> A. Upper sideband
> B. Lower sideband
> C. Vestigial sideband
> D. Double sideband
> **Answer: A** — above 10 meters the convention is USB — taught in chapter 2.

Published ID line: `G2A01 (A)`

> **G5A01** What is impedance?
> A. The opposition to AC current flow
> B. The inverse of resistance
> C. The power stored in an inductor
> D. The charge stored in a capacitor
> **Answer: A** — impedance is the total opposition to AC — taught in chapter 5.

Published ID line: `G5A01 (A)`

> **G7A09** What is the purpose of C1 in the circuit shown in Figure G7-1?
> A. It resonates with L1
> B. It removes RF from the supply rail
> C. It couples the output
> D. It sets the bias
> **Answer: A** — C1 is the tuning capacitor across L1 — taught in chapter 7.

Published ID line: `G7A09 (A)`
